tasks.label: Prepare GitHub Pages site
tasks.command: mkdir -p site && mv dashboard.html site/index.html && mv app.js style.css teaching_evaluation_consolidated.json ucb_logo.png site/

tasks.label: Inspect Git remote state
tasks.command: git remote -v && git status --short --branch && git fetch origin && git log --oneline --decorate --graph --all -10

tasks.label: Compare local and remote commits
tasks.command:
git status --short --branch && printf '%s
' '--- local-only / remote-only ---' && git log --oneline --left-right HEAD...origin/main && printf '%s
' '--- recent history ---' && git log --oneline --decorate --graph --all -12 && printf '%s
' '--- task file diff ---' && git diff -- .vscode/tasks.json
